researchMethod: WebFetch and direct HTTPS were blocked in this sandbox (DNS failure / egress proxy 403 for similarweb.com, artificialanalysis.ai, lmarena.ai, theresanaiforthat.com, futurepedia.io, openai.com, huggingface.co, producthunt.com, g2.com). Every fact below comes from WebSearch result summaries that quote the listed URL; no page was opened directly. Facts that only third-party pages support are marked 'third-party'. Re-verify on the live official page before acting, especially prices.

platforms.name: Similarweb Top Websites / Rank
platforms.methodology: traffic: 'Rank is a website traffic scoring method ... calculated based on a mix of our estimations of a site's monthly unique visitors and monthly pageviews across desktop and mobile web traffic.' Category rank = 'Highest sum of monthly unique visitors and page views for the category to which the primary website belongs.' Updated monthly. Connecting Google Analytics does not change rank.
platforms.keplarQualifiesReason: Any domain with enough estimated traffic is ranked automatically. A category such as 'AI Chatbots and Tools' exists (seen only in a third-party reprint of a table). Keplar would appear only once its traffic is large enough for Similarweb's panel to estimate.
platforms.requiresPaymentNote: Placement is free and automatic. Full data and API are paid and sales-led. A third-party tracker lists a Starter plan from $149/mo (unverified).
platforms.publicApiNote: Paid, credit-metered API. Docs say 'speak to your Similarweb Account Manager' to start. Docs: https://docs.similarweb.com/api-v5/guides/data-credits-calculations
platforms.listedAlreadyEvidence: unverified: similarweb.com could not be fetched from the sandbox to check keplar.one.
platforms.notes: Category assignment is Similarweb's choice, not the site owner's. The exact weights for visitors and pageviews are not published.

platforms.name: Artificial Analysis
platforms.methodology: benchmarks: Intelligence Index built from about ten evaluations (GDPval-AA, Terminal-Bench Hard, GPQA Diamond, HLE and others), plus speed, latency and price measurements of API provider endpoints. It reports coverage of '500+ models, 100+ inference providers, and 1,000+ endpoints'.
platforms.keplarQualifiesReason: It benchmarks models, API providers, hardware and search APIs. No consumer chat-app ranking was found. Keplar does not train or serve its own model.
platforms.publicApiNote: API at https://artificialanalysis.ai/api/v2. A free tier covers headline indices, pricing and median performance. Pro and Commercial tiers are paid. Docs: https://artificialanalysis.ai/api-reference/beta
platforms.listedAlreadyEvidence: Not applicable: the site lists models and providers only.
platforms.notes: Useful as a data source for Keplar's model-routing decisions and for marketing copy about the models it uses, not as a listing.

platforms.name: Hugging Face (Spaces / Open LLM Leaderboard)
platforms.methodology: benchmarks (Open LLM Leaderboard: 'We evaluated models on 6 key benchmarks using the Eleuther AI Language Model Evaluation Harness'). Spaces is ML demo hosting, not a ranking.
platforms.keplarQualifiesReason: Leaderboard submissions required 'a Transformers model with weights on the Hub'. Keplar has no weights. Also, the v1 leaderboard was archived in June 2024. Keplar could host a demo Space, but that is a hosting choice, not a ranking.
platforms.requiresPaymentNote: Spaces: static Spaces are free. Gradio and Docker Spaces on the free CPU tier now require a PRO subscription (users) or Team/Enterprise (orgs), per the current Hub docs.
platforms.publicApiNote: The Hub API (huggingface_hub) can create and manage Spaces: https://huggingface.co/docs/huggingface_hub/en/guides/manage-spaces
platforms.listedAlreadyEvidence: unverified: huggingface.co could not be fetched.
platforms.notes: The status of the newer leaderboard that replaced v1 was not confirmed (unverified).

platforms.name: Arena (formerly LMArena / LMSYS Chatbot Arena)
platforms.methodology: votes: a public leaderboard ranking models by aggregated human-preference votes on blind side-by-side responses. Listing requires 'at least 1,000 votes'. Eligible only if 'publicly available': open weights, public APIs with transparent pricing and documentation, or a widely accessible public-facing service.
platforms.keplarQualifiesReason: It ranks models that providers supply. No public submission form exists; listings come through collaboration with model providers. Keplar is an app that routes to third-party models, not a model provider.
platforms.notes: Renamed from LMArena to Arena on 2026-01-28 with domain arena.ai (per Wikipedia citing the Arena blog). Policy page last updated 2026-04-30.

platforms.name: There's An AI For That (TAAFT)
platforms.methodology: editorial directory with paid listing tiers (third-party sources only).
platforms.keplarQualifiesReason: Consumer AI tools are its core listing type.
platforms.submissionUrlNote: The official submit URL was not confirmed (unverified).
platforms.requiresPaymentNote: Third-party: G2 lists one-time editions from $49 (website listing) to $347 ('Maximum Exposure'). SaaSCity (2026-10-07) reports $49 to list, $437 for a newsletter spot, and a free route of one tool a month (from an X thread). Not confirmed on TAAFT's own site.
platforms.listedAlreadyEvidence: unverified: the site could not be fetched. A web search for 'Keplar One' / 'keplar.one' returned no TAAFT page.

platforms.name: Futurepedia
platforms.submissionUrlNote: An older cached https://futurepedia.io/submit-tool showed $247 Basic (sold out) and $497 Verified. SaaSCity (2026-10-07) says that page now returns 404 and the only route is a $497 'Verified Enhanced Listing' at futurepedia.io/enhanced. Neither is confirmed live (unverified).
platforms.requiresPaymentNote: $497 one-time (cached official page, plus third-party sources). No free route found.
platforms.listedAlreadyEvidence: unverified: the site could not be fetched. No search hit for Keplar.
platforms.notes: Third-party sources say outbound links are nofollow.

platforms.name: Product Hunt
platforms.methodology: votes plus editorial: daily launch leaderboard on Pacific time. The team decides which launches are featured (third-party).
platforms.submissionUrlNote: This is the official how-to article, referenced by a third-party guide and not opened directly.
platforms.requiresPaymentNote: A free personal account can post (third-party, 2026 review).
platforms.publicApiNote: GraphQL API v2 at https://api.producthunt.com/v2/api/graphql, OAuth or developer token. Docs: https://www.producthunt.com/v2/docs
platforms.listedAlreadyEvidence: unverified: the site could not be fetched. No search hit for Keplar.
platforms.notes: Plan the launch day. Featuring is editorial.

platforms.name: G2 (AI Chatbots category)
platforms.methodology: reviews: the Grid plots products by satisfaction and market presence from user reviews. Category inclusion requires meeting all feature criteria, e.g. a conversational interface 'powered by either stochastic generative models (e.g., LLMs) or intent-based NLU pipelines'.
platforms.keplarQualifiesReason: It is an LLM-powered conversational product. ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Perplexity are already in the category. Grid placement needs enough reviews.
platforms.requiresPaymentNote: 'Every company can claim and maintain a free G2 Profile'. Paid plans add customization and lead generation (pricing guide: https://sell.g2.com/hubfs/G2-External-Pricing-Guide-PDF-FY26.pdf).
platforms.requiresReviewNote: G2's research team reviews a new listing in about 3-5 business days (third-party, SaaSCity). Work email is verified to claim.
platforms.listedAlreadyEvidence: unverified: g2.com could not be fetched. No search hit for Keplar.
platforms.notes: G2 acquired Capterra, GetApp and Software Advice from Gartner (agreed January 2026, closed the following month, per third-party), so one G2 profile may also feed Capterra.

platforms.name: Capterra
platforms.keplarQualifiesReason: Software review site. The buyer audience is mostly business, so fit for a consumer app is weaker.
platforms.submissionUrlNote: Since the G2 acquisition, 'Get your product listed' may route to G2's product form (third-party, SaaSCity).
platforms.requiresPaymentNote: The free 'Launch' tier includes a profile. Promote (budgets up to $2K/mo) and Grow (up to $10K/mo) are PPC. A free profile reportedly has no website link (third-party).
platforms.listedAlreadyEvidence: unverified: no search hit for Keplar.

platforms.name: AlternativeTo
platforms.methodology: votes ('likes') from users, plus moderation of submissions.
platforms.keplarQualifiesReason: Can be listed as an alternative to ChatGPT, Poe or Perplexity. Third-party: 'thin AI wrappers' are not accepted, so the submission should stress the original features (synthesis, Deep Research, study mode).
platforms.submissionUrlNote: Per the FAQ: sign up, then User icon > 'Suggest new application'.
platforms.requiresPaymentNote: Free queue. A $5 priority review is reported by a third party only (unverified).
platforms.listedAlreadyEvidence: unverified: no search hit for Keplar.

platforms.name: Toolify.ai
platforms.requiresPaymentNote: Third-party only: $99 one-time, live within 48h, refund if rejected, no free route (SaaSCity 2026-10-07). An older blog says $49. Not confirmed officially.

platforms.name: Future Tools (futuretools.io)
platforms.methodology: editorial: human reviewers, final call by Matt Wolfe's team. 'Over 75% of the tools that are submitted ... do not get approved.'
platforms.keplarQualifiesReason: AI tool directory. Approval is selective.
platforms.submissionUrlNote: The submit form is referenced in the official FAQ. Its exact URL was not confirmed.
platforms.requiresPaymentNote: Submission is free. Featured listings are paid promotions.
platforms.notes: Wait a week before resubmitting, or the tool will almost certainly be skipped. Expect no reply either way.

platforms.name: SaaSHub
platforms.methodology: directory with alternatives pages and manual approval.
platforms.keplarQualifiesReason: Accepts SaaS/web products. Can be listed against ChatGPT, Poe and others.
platforms.requiresPaymentNote: Free listing and free verification (domain email or meta tag). Featured listing is $99/month (third-party).
platforms.notes: Verified listings reportedly get a followed link (SaaSCity), but sources conflict.

platforms.name: a16z Top 100 Gen AI Consumer Apps
platforms.methodology: traffic/usage: based on web traffic and mobile app usage ('most popular generative AI web products, based on monthly visits'). A 7th edition (reported 2026-10-05, third-party) adds a top-50 spending ranking from YipitData US consumer panels. The specific data vendors (Similarweb/Sensor Tower) were not confirmed.
platforms.keplarQualifiesReason: A consumer Gen-AI web app is in scope, but placement needs top-100 traffic. Not realistic near-term.
platforms.listedAlreadyEvidence: Inferred from search results; the list itself was not fetched (unverified).
platforms.notes: Editorial selection from traffic data. Published roughly twice a year (6th edition page dated 2026-03-09).

platforms.name: TopAI.tools
platforms.methodology: editorial: 'All tool submissions are subject to editorial review.'
platforms.requiresPaymentNote: Official submit page: $47 Fast Listing (live within 48h) or $229 Premium (premium placement for 7 days). Automatic refund if not accepted. One third-party source mentions a free path (unverified).
